description:
"What's that in Taiwanese Mandarin?" Just take a photo.
You get the meaning, a natural Taiwan voice, example sentences and the phrases people actually use, right there.
Your own photo becomes your flashcard. Free to start.

Looking a word up means a dictionary, then the pronunciation, then an example, then a flashcard. So you don't. Or you do, and it's gone the next time you see the thing.
CatchWords turns that moment into a word you keep. The thing you photographed becomes a sticker cut out of your own photo, goes into your collection, and comes back in your reviews.

■ Snap it, and the word appears
・Take a photo and you get word suggestions for each thing in it
・When people say it in more than one way, you see the everyday, casual and more specific words side by side, each with a short note (e.g. tissue: 面紙 / 衛生紙)
・Not among them? Look it up with "Type a different word"

■ Your photo becomes your own flashcard
・Zhuyin (bopomofo) or pinyin, the meaning, a natural Taiwanese Mandarin voice, example sentences, measure words, synonyms and related words. Sentences can be played too
・Every character in the examples carries its zhuyin or pinyin
・"How to use it": the patterns (chunks) native speakers use most, each with the situation it fits and an example, in order of how often they are used
・Example sentences use the vocabulary and grammar of the TOCFL level you set
・The date and place are saved, you can add a one-line note, and you can browse your words on a map
・Selfie mode puts you, or you and your friends, in the picture with the word
・Snap the same thing again and the word collects more photos

■ A collection you want to fill
・Words line up in a collection by category. Words you haven't caught yet show as silhouettes, so you always know what to learn next
・Home builds an album of the words you caught each day

■ Reviews show the things you photographed
・Spaced repetition (SRS) brings each word back as a 4-choice question just before you forget it, with your own photo as the cue
・Every word's memory state is shown in color and as a curve, so you can see which ones keep slipping
・Optional reminders at review time, and when you pass near a place where you caught a word
・A Home Screen widget shows today's word

■ Made for
・A trip, a semester or a working holiday in Taiwan: learn the words for the things you see every day
・People who couldn't stick with vocabulary books or language apps
・Learners who want Traditional Chinese and zhuyin, and the words used in Taiwan, not textbook Mandarin

■ Price
・Free. You can catch 10 words a day in your first week, then 5 a day. Watch a short video ad to catch one more that day
・Browsing and reviewing your words is never limited

■ Your data
・Photos are analyzed and word explanations written by external AI services. The app shows what is sent and asks for your consent first. Without consent you can still browse and review the words you have
・You can delete your account at any time in Settings

Interface: English, Japanese, Traditional Chinese
Language you learn: Taiwanese Mandarin (Traditional Chinese)

Privacy Policy: https://catchwords.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://catchwords.app/terms
